key.name: show-logo-button
key.description: A logo at the top bar's far left with the system menu (About This System, Settings, App Store, Extensions, Sleep, Restart, Shut Down). Stands aside while WACK Shell shows its own logo.

key.name: logo-icon-name
key.description: fedora: Fedora's emblem, in monochrome. apple: an apple. distro: your distribution's own logo (os-release). custom: the image in logo-custom-path. none: the label only.

key.name: logo-custom-path
key.description: An SVG or PNG, used when logo-icon-name is custom.

key.name: show-logo-label
key.description: Text beside the logo (logo-label-text).

key.name: logo-label-text
key.description: Finder, MK, your name... Empty: the logo only.

key.name: calendar-quick-add
key.description: Opens the calendar with the reminder box ready to type in (again: closes it).

key.name: snap-layouts
key.description: Five layouts; 1-5 tiles the focused window and the others on this desktop.

key.name: coder-desktop
key.description: An editor, a terminal and a browser on localhost onto a fresh desktop, side by side.

key.name: dock
key.description: The glass dock. It only shows while Dash to Dock is off.

key.name: dock-style
key.description: obsidian-glass: translucent dark smoke. cupertino-frost: bright diffused glass. spider-glow: a dark core with a red laser edge. minimal-flat: a solid dark shelf, no border or blur.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: The icons' size at rest; they grow under the pointer (dock-hover-scale).

key.name: dock-hover-scale
key.description: How much the icon right under the pointer grows (and it lifts 12 px); icons nearby grow less, on a smooth bell that reaches 120 px. 1.00: none.

key.name: dock-hide-ms
key.description: How long the dock takes to fade away when a window covers it. 140 for a snappy dock.

key.name: dock-reveal-ms
key.description: How long it takes to come back. 130 for a snappy dock.

key.name: blur
key.description: Blur behind the top bar islands, the dock and the switcher. Paused while a window is full screen; off while Blur my Shell is on.

key.name: fresh-snip
key.description: The screenshot tool opens with no box (not last time's): drag any area.

key.name: snip-auto-capture
key.description: Letting go of a new area takes the screenshot at once (saved and copied).

key.name: top-bar-style
key.description: islands: three floating glass capsules. edge: one seamless glass bar.

key.name: show-active-app
key.summary: Active app in the top bar
key.description: The focused app's icon (in its own colours) and name, with a menu for its window.

key.name: autohide-top-bar
key.description: While a window has focus the top bar glides away; the top edge, an empty desktop or the overview bring it back. Windows get its space while this is on.

key.name: tray-collapsed
key.description: Apps' tray icons sit behind the chevron at the start of the right island; a click shows them.

key.name: media-previous
key.description: One press, one skip: key repeat is ignored and presses within 350 ms count once.

key.name: media-next
key.description: One press, one skip: key repeat is ignored and presses within 350 ms count once.

key.name: qs-hidden
key.description: Any of dark-style, airplane-mode, welcome-light. [] shows everything.
